We have quickly become America’s fastest-growing home improvement company—providing premium roofing, bathroom remodeling, and siding solutions to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve. 
 As an Outside Sales Representative, you’ll run pre-set, qualified appointments, educate homeowners on our roofing, bathroom remodeling, or siding solutions and close projects in-home.
 $4,000 SIGN-ON BONUS 
 What You’ll Do 
- Run pre-set, qualified appointments with homeowners—no cold calling or lead generation required.
- Conduct professional in-home design consultations, design custom showers using proprietary rendering software, provide same-day estimates, and execute a one-sit close.
- Partner with your Sales Manager and team for ongoing coaching, joint appointments, weekly meetings, and skill development.
 What’s In It for You  
- 100% commission W-2 role with uncapped earnings + monthly bonuses.
- On target earnings between $150K–$320K+ annually.
- Pre-set qualified leads—focus on closing, not prospecting.
- 4 weeks paid training at $1,000/week, plus earn full commission — not a draw.
- Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
- $4,000 Sign-On Bonus.
- Monthly car allowance
- Cell phone allowance & company provided iPad
 What It Takes To Succeed  
- Resilience and ability to handle rejection without being discouraged.
- Ability to drive 100 miles a day on average.
- Availability to work evenings and weekends.
- Comfortable working in a commission-based role.
- Technological proficiency in using an iPad.
- Submit to a background screening.
- Valid driver's license and vehicle insurance.
 More About TIMEPROOFUSA 
 TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we’re building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time. 
 Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity & Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren’t just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together. 
 If you’re the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that’s changing the industry, this is your moment. 
 Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let’s build something extraordinary together.

title: Account Manager – Local Government (Northern Midwest)
body:
Overview 
 We invite you to bring your experience and passion for state and local government coupled with an understanding of applying geospatial technology to become an integral part of Esri’s State and Local Government account team. We’re looking for an individual who is customer oriented and a collaborative team player who enjoys identifying and implementing strategies that will radically improve the challenges organizations face. You’ll work closely with a team that helps new and existing state and local government customers optimize and expand adoption of Esri technology, identify new areas of growth, and share expertise that helps deliver on their mission.
 At Esri, we are committed to our customers and their success. It is a place for you to do your best work and partner with our customers amid a supportive culture that encourages creativity, collaboration, and passion.
 Responsibilities 
- Build relationships. Prospect, develop, and implement location strategies for organizations. Maintain a healthy pipeline of business growth opportunities for new and existing customers. Leverage social media and other avenues to build your professional network. Participate and present at trade shows, workshops, and seminars.
- Understand our customers. Demonstrate industry knowledge and its relevance to the application of GIS. Identify key stakeholders and business drivers for an organization. Understand customer budgeting and acquisition processes. Use solution selling skills to understand the needs and business challenges of customers.
- Learn and grow. Clearly articulate the strength and value of Esri technology as it relates to the state and local government industry. Consistently conduct research and pursue professional development to anticipate customer needs and trends that may impact them.
- Deliver results. Successfully execute the account management and sales processes for all opportunities. Use whiteboard sessions and other techniques to support visual storytelling and propose solutions that best meet the need of the customer.
- Collaborate with your team. Leverage your domain knowledge when working with teams across Esri to define and execute account strategies. Be motivated and resourceful and take initiative to resolve issues.
 Requirements 
- 2+ years of enterprise sales and/or relevant consulting or program management experience
- Experience creating partnerships, and establishing yourself as a trusted advisor with customers
- Understanding of account management, account planning and opportunity strategy creation
- Demonstrated knowledge of state and local government and new technology trends and the ability to translate this into solutions for customers
- Able to negotiate, present, and support visual storytelling across all levels of an organization
- Ability to travel domestically or internationally 25-50%
- Bachelor’s degree in GIS, business administration, or a related field
- Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
 Recommended Qualifications 
- Understanding of GIS, Esri technology, and state and local government as they relate to one another
- Experience managing the sales life cycle
- General knowledge of data science or spatial analysis and how it is used for problem solving and uncovering patterns and trends within organizations
- Knowledge of industry fiscal year, budgeting, and procurement cycles
- Master’s degree in GIS, business administration, or a related field

title: Application Developer - JavaScript
body:
Overview 
 We are seeking an Application Developer to join Esri’s Geo Experience Center team, where you will contribute to building prototype applications that explore digital cartography, advanced map visualizations, and web-based GIS experiences. This role focuses on hands-on application development using JavaScript, TypeScript, ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, and modern web application frameworks to test ideas, visualize complex spatial data, and support early-stage innovation.
 You will work on thought leadership demonstrations and prototypes that push the boundaries of Esri’s geospatial tools and technology, with an emphasis on applying web-based ArcGIS capabilities in new and creative ways. You would be working within a diverse team creating prototypical applications informed by real-world use cases and customer needs to creatively apply Esri’s geospatial technology.
 Responsibilities 
- Develop and maintain prototype applications and proofs of concept using JavaScript, TypeScript, and ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript
- Contribute to the design and implementation of user experiences for web applications, digital cartographic visualizations, and interactive map-based workflows
- Assist in prototyping and experimenting with novel web-based maps, scenes, and spatial data visualizations, helping explore how geospatial information can be effectively represented in browser-based contexts
- Work with modern web application frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte, or Vue to build targeted, stand-alone web applications and reusable UI components
- Collaborate with core development and SDK teams during release development sprints, providing feedback on APIs, beta capabilities, tools, workflows, documentation, and developer experience
- Explore and apply emerging web visualization capabilities, including WebGL and browser-based real-time visualization, to support advanced 2D, 3D, and multidimensional spatial experiences
- Evolve coding and development skills by staying current with JavaScript, TypeScript, complementary programming languages, development practices, coding tools, and user interface design techniques
 Requirements 
- 2+ years of experience developing web applications using JavaScript; TypeScript experience preferred
- Experience with modern web application frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, Svelte, or similar technologies
- Experience with code management systems and CI/CD
- Foundational understanding of digital cartography, data visualization, or geospatial application development
- Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, GIS, or related field
- Ability to travel domestically or internationally up to 25–50%
- Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
 Recommended Qualifications 
- Familiarity with ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, ArcGIS Experience Builder, or other Esri web technologies
- Interest in geospatial technology and applying innovative approaches to solve complex visualization and application development challenges
- Experience with WebGL, 3D visualization, or browser-based real-time rendering technologies
- Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, GIS, or a related field

title: Consultant - Gas and Electric
body:
Overview 
 In this position, you will work closely with clients to establish solutions to make them successful, broaden the effect of GIS technology to their business, and help shape the evolution of the platform by identifying new implementation patterns. You will provide solutions and thought leadership while promoting the use of Esri technology to enable customer success and support its development and growth into new domains by working closely with industry experts throughout the company.
 This team supports our Utilities clients. You will be part of a talented cross-functional team of dynamic and passionate consultants and project managers to deliver solutions that enable our customers to make a difference in communities around the world. You will be part of a delivery team that implements critical technologies that improve quality, reliability and accessibility to data and geospatial capabilities.
 Working alongside industry experts at Esri, you will help utilities modernize their geospatial infrastructure, improve data quality and accessibility, and expand the impact of GIS across their organizations.
 As part of Esri’s Professional Services division, you will work on high-impact projects that enable customers to improve electric and gas transmission and distribution geo-enablement supporting improved asset management practices, operational efficiency, and service reliability for electric and gas utilities around the world.
 Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Minneapolis, MN area for this position.
 Responsibilities 
- Help clients translate complex electric and gas utility challenges into practical, state-of-the-art GIS solutions, with a strong emphasis on implementing ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Utility Network, and ArcGIS Solutions
- Collaborate with clients to prepare enterprise geospatial strategies, including multi-year implementation and migration roadmaps
- Collect, organize, and present client requirements, objectives, and business workflows—including asset management, field operations, and data management - to develop actionable ArcGIS Enterprise solutions
- Analyze and interpret business and technical problems specific to electric and gas utilities, delivering practical, customer-focused solutions
- Advise customers on enterprise GIS strategies and product selection, with a focus on ArcGIS Enterprise and Utility Network
- Lead project management activities, including planning, execution, and delivery of electric and gas utilities GIS projects, ensuring alignment with client goals and successful customer outcomes
- Create and manage scope, cost, schedule, and deliverables through planning, tracking, quality assurance, change control, and risk management
- Manage small to large-scale projects and lead project teams through requirements, analysis, design, build, and rollout
- Track project performance and communicate status with internal teams and customer stakeholders
- Work with Esri’s marketing and sales teams to support business development, expand into new application areas, and deliver solutions to new and existing customers
- Manage client relationships and maintain a strong focus on customer success and long-term partnership
 Requirements 
- 5+ years of hands-on experience applying ArcGIS Enterprise in production environments
- 5+ years of experience working within the electric & gas utility industry
- Demonstrated expertise with ArcGIS Utility Network concepts and implementations
- Experience using and configuring Esri products including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Utility Network, ArcGIS Field Maps, and ArcGIS Solutions
- Ability to connect utility business workflows (asset management, field operations, data management, and more) to ArcGIS solutions
- Strong client-facing experience with a proven ability to understand customer needs and deliver effective solutions
- Experience contributing to or leading complex, multi-stakeholder projects
- Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work independently
- Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects or activities in parallel
- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, GIS, geography, or a related field
- Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
 Recommended Qualifications 
- Experience in integrating business systems with ArcGIS to support work management, asset management, SCADA, customer information, and document management
- Knowledge of RDBMS and geodatabase design, with best practices in data management
- Familiarity with mobile applications for data collection of electric and gas utilities assets
- Experience contributing to GIS strategies, enterprise deployments, or modernization initiatives within the utilities industry

title: Solution Engineer Team Lead - State and Local Government (Minneapolis)
body:
Overview 
 At Esri, our solution engineer team leads are part of a highly skilled technical team that promotes and sells the adoption of Esri technology in partnership with account managers and other Esri staff. We invite you to use your coaching and team-building skills, as well as your experience with geospatial technology, to become an integral part of the state & local government solution engineering team. We’re looking for an individual who inspires and motivates others and who enjoys implementing strategies that will radically improve the challenges our customers face. You’ll lead a team that helps customers take advantage of geospatial analysis to find unique patterns and trends hidden within complex business problems. 
 At Esri, we are committed to our customers and their success. It is a place for you to do your best work and partner with our customers amid a supportive culture that encourages creativity, collaboration, and passion.
 Responsibilities 
- Empower your team. Manage the technical activities of your solution engineer team by working with account and sales managers to strategically lead all technical stages of the sales process. Mentor your team through active coaching, clear direction, and regular feedback. Cultivate a virtual team to support sales objectives and generate results.
- Build relationships. Present, demonstrate, and support selling Esri software and solutions as part of the account team. Gain access to technical enterprise-level decision makers and lead technical meetings that drive revenue. Partner closely with Sales leadership to align team strategies and goals.
- Be an expert. Be a technical leader of ArcGIS as well as a subject matter expert of state & local government. Demonstrate your advanced understanding of sales strategies and initiatives to develop complex solutions for Esri’s most strategic customers. 
- Solve problems . Proactively craft and propose solutions that clarify how GIS brings business value to our customers by addressing the critical business challenges they face. Define and deliver complex strategies that align Esri technology with our largest customers’ business needs. Understand an organization’s business structure, associated workflows, third party business systems, and integration points.
- Tell our story. Design presentations for technical and non-technical audiences within Esri’s largest customers. Provide configuration guidance and best practices. Empower others to present at large conferences, trade shows and executive engagements.
 Requirements 
- 8+ years of experience with Esri technology creating maps, performing spatial analysis, and configuring web applications
- 3+ years of experience mentoring, motivating, and coaching on a team
- Advanced understanding of current GIS technology, including the full ArcGIS system to demonstrate Esri’s patterns of use for state & local government industry
- Broad knowledge of ArcGIS from an IT context (such as hardware, software, storage, security, networking, servers, databases, web services, virtualization, cloud computing)
- Demonstrated experience in technical consulting and conceptual solution design
- Demonstrated experience of actively participating in a sales process
- Remarkable presentation, interpersonal, and listening skills
- Ability to travel domestically or internationally up to 50%
- Bachelor’s degree in geography, GIS, business administration, or a related field
- Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
 Recommended Qualifications 
- Master’s degree in geography, GIS, business administration, or a related field

title: Sr. GIS Solution Engineer - Commercial
body:
Overview 
 GIS Solution Engineers on our commercial team are highly technical, trusted advisors to customers across many different commercial markets working with some of the largest and most complex companies around the world. They inspire customers supporting mission-critical work pushing GIS to new heights, solving business challenges and providing a competitive edge through location intelligence. Not only do they create innovative solutions, they talk about solutions in ways that get others excited about the power of GIS technology.
 Solution Engineers collaborate across Esri and advise customers on their most complex business challenges. Leveraging problem-solving and critical listening skills, they demonstrate the value of GIS finding unique patterns, trends, and understanding. Each day poses new challenges and new discoveries with ArcGIS. At Esri, your ideas and curiosity are celebrated, and a growth mindset isn’t just encouraged – it’s the standard.
 Responsibilities 
- Build relationships. Present, demonstrate, and support selling Esri software and solutions as part of the account team. Gain access to technical enterprise-level decision makers and lead technical meetings that drive revenue.
- Be an expert. Be a technical leader of Esri technology as well as a subject matter expert of commercial industries including insurance, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, media, entertainment, real estate and more. Demonstrate your advanced understanding of sales strategies and initiatives to develop complex solutions for Esri’s most strategic customers. Understand an organization’s business structure, associated workflows, third party business systems, and integration points. Share knowledge and coach new team members on best practices.
- Solve problems . Proactively craft and propose solutions that clarify how GIS brings business value to our customers by addressing the critical challenges they face. Define and deliver complex strategies that align Esri technology with our largest customers’ business needs.
- Tell our story. Design presentations for technical and non-technical audiences within Esri’s largest customers. Provide configuration guidance and best practices. Present at large conferences and executive engagements.
 Requirements 
- 5+ years of experience with Esri technology creating maps, performing spatial analysis, and configuring web applications
- 3+ years of experience in Hi-Tech, Media & Entertainment, Consumer Goods & Services, or Financial Services
- Broad knowledge of ArcGIS from an IT context (such as hardware, storage, security, networking, web services, virtualization, cloud computing)
- Demonstrated experience in technical consulting and conceptual solution design
- Understanding of sales and business development processes
- Ability to troubleshoot client issues related to Esri application deployment and system architecture
- Experience with geodatabases and underlying DBMS technology
- Knowledge of cloud computing concepts and environments (Microsoft Azure or AWS)
- Experience in integrating software solutions with other business systems including data warehousing, BI, CRM, ERP, and analytics platforms
- Programming and scripting experience with languages such as Python and JavaScript
- Remarkable presentation, interpersonal, and listening skills
- Ability to travel domestically or internationally 25-50%
- Bachelor's degree in geography, computer science, or a related field
- Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
 Recommended Qualifications 
- Experience incorporating real-time information streams with existing GIS data and IT infrastructure
- Knowledge of modern digital strategies that include mobile, IoT, advanced analytics and data science (AI/ML), and imagery
- Detailed knowledge and experience working with dedicated and hybrid cloud architectures along with different approaches to system integration, ETL workflows, analytics and data science
- Master’s degree in geography, computer science, or a related field

title: Sr. Partner Manager
body:
Overview 
 Our senior partner managers build and strengthen relationships with business partners and systems integrators to collaboratively sell and promote the adoption of Esri’s technology. We invite you to use your experience and passion to increase revenue, drive Esri’s presence in various industries, and identify key partner solutions. You will work closely with internal teams across the organization and Esri’s distributor network to help partners take full advantage of our technology and market presence.
 At Esri, we are committed to our customers and their success. It is a place for you to do your best work and partner with our customers amid a supportive culture that encourages creativity, collaboration, and passion.
 Responsibilities 
- Manage Partner Relationships. Develop and maintain productive relationships with assigned partners within the Esri Partner Network. Build trusted connections with partner stakeholders and support executive engagement as needed. Communicate effectively across internal and partner teams to ensure alignment on goals, priorities, and execution plans.
- Drive Pipeline & Revenue Execution. Own partner-influenced and partner-sourced pipeline targets for assigned accounts or segments. Execute joint account planning and co-sell motions to progress opportunities and close deals. Monitor pipeline health, forecasts, and performance metrics to improve deal velocity and results.
- Execute Joint Go-to-Market Initiatives. Independently execute co-sell and resell engagements aligned to regional or industry priorities. Enable partner teams on Esri offerings, messaging, and sales motions. Collaborate with sales, marketing, and business development teams to support coordinated campaigns and opportunity progression.
- Apply Solution Selling & Market Insight. Articulate differentiated value propositions and clearly communicate ROI to customer decision makers. Apply market analysis concepts to identify growth opportunities and competitive positioning. Contribute insights to support industry strategies and targeted marketing efforts.
- Structure & Negotiate Agreements. Independently structure and negotiate moderately complex agreements within established program guidelines, including pricing, discounts, and participation models. Balance partner and company objectives while identifying risks and ensuring scalable, repeatable deal structures.
 Requirements 
- 5+ years of enterprise sales, partner management, alliance management, or related experience
- Experience driving partner-influenced or partner-supported pipeline and revenue growth
- Demonstrated proficiency in solution selling and consultative engagement with enterprise customers
- Strong understanding of pipeline management concepts, forecasting, and deal progression
- Experience executing co-sell or reseller go-to-market motions
- Ability to negotiate moderately complex agreements within established frameworks
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills across internal and external stakeholders
- Ability to operate independently and manage competing priorities
- Technical familiarity with enterprise software platforms
- Familiarity with Esri technology in support of partner campaigns across the lifecycle (planning, targeting, analysis, communications)
- Ability to travel domestically or internationally 25–50%
- Bachelor’s degree in GIS, business administration, or a related field

 Recommended Qualifications

Location: Minneapolis, MN 
 Hires local to the Twin Cities Metro-Area can anticipate an in-office component of 1-2 days a week, employed with Bold Orange. If this position lists, “Open to Remote”, hires outside of the metro area can anticipate travel to our Minneapolis, MN office on an as-requested basis. We value human connection and some travel is anticipated.  
 About Bold Orange: 
 Bold Orange (BOCO) is a customer experience company. We believe authentic human connections are the single most important driver of business and societal progress. We exist to create these connections across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition to engagement to retention. Our culture is one of curiosity, collaboration, proactivity and always bringing the outside, future focused perspective to our clients. 
 Position Summary: 
 Bold Orange is seeking a curious, versatile, and business-minded Associate Strategy Director to help our clients solve complex customer and growth challenges. 
 Strategy at Bold Orange sits at the intersection of business, brand, customer experience, data and technology. Our strategists help define the problem, determine the right approach, develop the strategy, and stay connected through execution. Our work spans the end-to-end customer lifecycle from awareness to conversion to retention, which means you might be shaping a value proposition or go-to-market strategy on one engagement and designing a customer journey, CRM strategy or experience roadmap on another.
 At the Associate Director level, you’ll independently lead strategy engagements from ambiguous client questions through actionable recommendations. You’ll facilitate senior client conversations, guide other strategists, collaborate closely with Creative, UX, Analytics, Technology and Client Services, and remain hands-on in the development of the work.
 We’re especially interested in strategists who have worked across both upstream business, brand and go-to-market challenges and downstream customer experience, CRM and lifecycle challenges. You don't need to be a MarTech implementer, but you should understand how data, audiences, platforms, channels, and journeys come together to create connected customer experiences.
 Duties and Responsibilities:  
- Lead the end-to-end development of strategy projects like: brand creation and value prop development; campaigns and go-to-market plans; experience mapping and journey design, messaging hierarchy and content strategy, developing near and long-term roadmaps. 
- Work collaboratively with client services/account management to intake client business challenges and opportunities and translate them into a well-defined approach or project plan that delivers against the objectives.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Creative, Design, UX, Analytics, and Technology, to gather requirements upfront—and stick around to ensure the strategic vision is executed seamlessly.
- Facilitate senior-level client conversations related to how we approach and deliver our work, giving them the “why” behind the “what.”
- Translate research, industry trends, competitive analysis, and data insights into compelling strategic recommendations. 
- Map, audit, and analyze customer journeys and experiences, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization, and building the roadmap to deliver them. 
- Conduct and analyze qualitative and quantitative research, including stakeholder interviews, surveys, 3rd-party tools like SEMRush or MRI Simmons, Hotjar, Persado, etc. 
- Advocate for user-centered design methodologies and incorporate a human-centered POV into strategic planning.
- Stay ahead of emerging industry trends, digital innovations, and marketing technology advancements to bring forward strategic recommendations. 
- Create and deliver compelling presentations and strategic storytelling in PowerPoint, Miro, and other tools. 
- Manage and mentor early career strategists, fostering professional growth and development.
 Required Qualifications and Experience:  
- Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or equivalent certifications/work experience.
- 8+ years relevant work experience in digital marketing, customer experience, brand strategy or content strategy roles. Agency or consultancy experience is required.
- Working knowledge and experience with martech strategy and platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Braze, AEM) including the creation or modification of journeys, segments, campaigns, etc. 
- Comfortable working in cross-functional teams that require deep collaboration with designers, analysts, developers, marketers, and more. 
- Ability to synthesize data and research findings that tease out insights beyond simple reporting; we are the storytellers that paint the picture and design the roadmap.
- Experience in a “lead” role on an account or with a client, encompassing strategic leadership at both the project and account level.
- Experience designing and architecting projects and scopes of work. 
 You’ll thrive in this role if you:  
- Like turning messy questions into structured problems. 
- Have strong opinions, loosely held. 
- Are as comfortable in a working session as you are in a polished presentation. 
- Can zoom from business strategy to the details of a customer journey. 
- Get energy from collaborating with people who know things you don't. 
- Are willing to challenge the brief when you think we're solving the wrong problem. 
- Enjoy making other strategists better, not just doing great work yourself. 
- Are curious about what is changing outside the walls of the agency and bring it back to clients.

body:

 About Bold Orange: 
 Bold Orange (BOCO) is a customer experience company. We believe authentic human connections are the single most important driver of business and societal progress. Our culture is one of curiosity, collaboration, proactivity and always bringing the outside, future focused perspective to our clients.
Position Summary: 
Lead-level, hands-on data engineering role centered on Snowflake. You will own the technical solution for your accounts end to end, from discovery and requirements through architecture, build, and production, and you will be the person clients and internal teams look to for the answer on how the data platform should work.
 Leads at Bold Orange take on the most critical and complex engineering work and are expected to be prolific contributors to the team's code, while also setting technical direction, establishing engineering practices, and multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around them.
 Snowflake powers a SaaS platform we operate and a growing share of our client data work, and it is where we are investing to get stronger, so deep and demonstrable Snowflake expertise is central to this role. We also work with Redshift and Databricks, both internally and on behalf of clients.
 You will work alongside solution architects, other data engineers, project managers, and client teams across multiple concurrent engagements.
Duties and Responsibilities: 
- Own the technical solution and provide overall technical oversight for your accounts, from discovery through production and ongoing support
- Lead discovery, intake requirements directly from clients, and present solutions and trade-offs to client stakeholders yourself
- Lead the architecture and own the system design for your engagements, including the data models, warehouses, and ELT/ETL pipelines that result
- Evaluate and estimate work confidently and accurately at the system and project level, not only at the component level
- Architect, build, and maintain data models, warehouses, and pipelines in Snowflake, optimizing for performance, scalability, and cost
- Take on the most critical, complex, and time-sensitive engineering work, and remain a prolific contributor to the team's code
- Develop and tune complex SQL, stored procedures, and transformations in Snowflake and supporting relational databases such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
- Apply native Snowflake capabilities where they earn their place, including Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, dynamic tables, and external and stage integrations for near-real-time data flows
- Own Snowflake performance, governance, and cost management across accounts, including warehouse sizing, clustering, role-based access control, and data security
- Design, build, and maintain back-end APIs and services in Python and C#/.NET that feed and consume the Snowflake platform
- Design and own integrations with client and internal marketing, CRM, and analytics platforms, including the authentication, error handling, and monitoring that keep an integration reliable once it is in production
- Own the CI/CD and deployment path for the systems you build, across cloud and on-premise environments
- Establish, socialize, implement, measure, and iterate on engineering practices for the data practice, and raise the bar through code review, design review, and written architecture decisions
- Delegate effectively and multiply the team: set technical direction, review designs before code is written, pair on hard problems, and grow depth on Snowflake and back-end development
- Create and lead training for both internal teams and client teams on the solutions you build
- Act as the technical escalation point for production issues in a multi-client environment, and own the fix and the follow-up so the same failure does not recur
- Own the majority of project-level technical communication with senior internal stakeholders and with clients, and guide the team on how to communicate well
- Participate in new business scoping and pursuits in your area of expertise
- Contribute to the agency's technical reputation through internal knowledge sharing and external representation such as writing, industry events, and panels
- Evaluate new platform capabilities and AI-assisted development tooling, and bring the ones that hold up into how the team works
Required Qualifications: 
- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with the majority of it in data engineering
- Demonstrated technical leadership: owning the technical solution for an account, engagement, or team, and being accountable for work beyond your own
- Deep hands-on Snowflake expertise: production experience designing data models and warehouses, building ELT/ETL pipelines, and writing performant SQL on the platform
- Demonstrated ownership of a data model or data platform design from requirements through production, not just implementation of someone else's design
- Experience leading discovery and shaping a technical solution directly with clients or business stakeholders, not only delivering against a specification handed to you
- Ability to estimate and plan work accurately at the system and project level
- Working knowledge of Snowflake performance tuning, cost optimization, and security and governance, including warehouse sizing, clustering, and RBAC
- Strong proficiency in Python and C# for back-end development, with recent hands-on work in both
- Hands-on experience with relational SQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL
- Proven experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs
- Practical DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and server configuration
- Comfort in both Windows Server and Linux environments
- A track record of establishing engineering standards or practices that other engineers followed
- Ability to manage and context-switch across multiple concurrent client projects
- Strong written and verbal communication, including technical communication with non-technical stakeholders and the confidence to lead a design conversation with a client
Preferred Qualifications: 
- Agency, consultancy, or client-services experience, with multiple concurrent clients and client-facing scoping and delivery
- Active SnowPro certification, Core strongly preferred, Advanced (Data Engineer or Architect) a significant plus. We support and pay for certification, so a strong engineer without it is not ruled out
- Working fluency with AI-assisted development tools, applied with engineering judgment about where they help and where they do not
- Experience with recent Snowflake platform capabilities, including CoCo, CoWork, Horizon Catalog, and Horizon Context (Semantic Views)
- Redshift and/or Databricks experience, both of which are in use at Bold Orange
- Azure DevOps, Azure App Services, or other Azure services
- HubSpot CMS, HubSpot APIs, or marketing automation platforms
- IIS, .NET deployment, or Windows service management

Snowflake certifications are strongly preferred. Responsibiltes: 
Presales Strategy & Platform Expertise 
- Partner with Growth, Client Service, and Technical Delivery teams to provide presales Snowflake expertise across new business pursuits, RFPs, and strategic account expansions in the context of using data solutions to impact customer experience and drive business outcomes.

 Snowflake Platform Ownership & SME

 Partner Alliance Support

title: Program Manager
body:
CourtAvenue is a company of industry experts accelerating digital transformation for the world’s most ambitious companies. 
 At CourtAvenue, you will be a part of a culture powered by entrepreneurs, technologists, data scientists and the habitually restless dedicated and energized to design products and services that transform businesses while optimizing them for growth. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow within a culture that values innovation while focusing on redesigning the experience between consumer and service (or product) by leveraging a fluid, seamless, and thoroughly transparent engagement. 
 Our Client Operations team establishes and manages the approach and standard for project delivery and governance, ensuring that clients maximize their return on investment. Responsible for team performance, client operations leaders provide team members with the tools, support, and training essential to deliver the most effective and inventive result possible. 
 A CourtAvenue Program Manager takes ownership of all projects within a program to ensure completion on time, within budget and against set objectives. Confidence and creativity are key to addressing business needs, managing resources, and handling any issues that may arise.
Responsibilities
- Own the day-to-day management of projects from initiation through implementation and deployment
- Ensure controls are followed, with the highest quality deliverables and milestones met
- Effectively balance resourcing, budgets, and time constraints to manage risks and pre-empt issues
- Develop contracts and design innovative delivery teams to best meet and exceed program objectives
- Evaluate and improve delivery practices and methodology
- Lead, inspire and grow a group of project managers/producers to foster a highly innovative, effective, and successful team
- Collaborate with the Account Management team to provide strategic delivery insight for client roadmaps and briefings
- Create integrated timelines across agency and client stakeholder teams
- Build relationships with external and internal stakeholders to meet program outcomes while exceeding client expectations
- Ensure a collaborative ‘one team’ approach of both client and agency
- Contribute to new business and pitch initiatives to secure a pipeline of work for the broader initiative
- Serve as the main client interface on projects
- Effectively clarify strategic requirements, manage expectations, and communicate roadblocks/resolutions to ensure key deadlines are met
- Communicate succinctly within a wide range of positions, personalities, and roles, internally and externally
Requirements
- 4-7+ years of analyst, project management, program management, technical, and/or business experience
- Understanding of agile software development methodologies, specifically Scrum
- Agency experience is required
- Experience in running or working with agile teams
- Significant experience leading, mentoring, and inspiring teams towards excellence and success
- Demonstrable ability to operate under tight deadlines
- Able to understand, balance, and manage the interplay between people, processes and systems
- Excellence in organization and management; conscientious, and skilled at solving issues at all project levels while supporting colleagues and clients
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Work Environment
Our organization follows a structured-hybrid work model, where employees work in an office environment on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and remotely on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.

 Candidates for this position will ideally be located near our offices located in:
- Chicago, IL
- Cincinnati, OH
- Minneapolis, MN
- 
 Candidates located in San Diego or Los Angeles, CA as well as Dallas, TX, Austin, TX or Bentonville, AR will also be considered.

title: Dynamics 365 F&O Principal Consultant - Finance
body:
Stoneridge Software began with the desire and understanding of what it takes to succeed in implementing business software solutions for the benefit of client’s business goals. Stoneridge founders recognized the need for a strategic business partner who could not only deliver software implementations but excel at it. As a 2025 Top Workplace Honoree, a member of the Microsoft Inner Circle, and an award-winning Microsoft Solutions Partner, we have crafted a meticulous approach to project delivery. Our commitment to long-term support empowers our client’s success, and we approach our work with integrity, tenacity and a culture of continuous improvement.  
 As a Stoneridge team member, it is important to us that your work is balanced with the rest of your life. We foster a flexible work environment and promote a remote-forward culture with team members located across North America. We have office locations in Fargo, ND and Minneapolis, MN that serve as key collaboration hubs. In-person work at these locations is encouraged and, at times, required. Team members should expect to travel to these offices as needed based on role expectations, project requirements, team collaboration, training, or other business-driven needs. Team members at Stoneridge benefit from an environment of collaboration and curiosity, backed up by continuous learning opportunities, personalized development plans, flexible time off, and many more benefits. We strive to maintain inclusive benefits that bring a sense of belonging to all of our team members. 
 It's our mission to help clients win through intentional leadership, thoughtful teaching, and eye-opening possibilities. With specialties in the entire suite of Microsoft Dynamics business applications and complementary Microsoft technologies, Stoneridge focuses on not only attracting the most knowledgeable, tenacious consulting experts in the field but building up that expertise from within. Come join us on this exciting journey!  
 Stoneridge Software is looking for a Principal Consultant to lead implementation efforts for Supply Chain Management in Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (F&O) . As part of a cross-functional team, you will be responsible for business process and application design, mapping to client business requirements, ensuring solutions align with business goals within supply chain management. The core part of our team’s mission is to help our clients win. This role will require in-depth D365 SCM and implementation experience as well as someone who is passionate about continuing to learn and grow while helping others be successful. From gathering requirements through guiding our clients through best practices, you will play a key part of our mission to ensure our clients’ success.
A Day in the Life
- 
 Design the supply chain solution and perform setup for the client's including business processes, system configuration, customization, and integration with third party applications   
- 
 Facilitate discussions with business and technical stakeholders to extract critical business requirements and present a technical vision and solutions in the form of process design, software products, customizations, and integrations to meet those needs   
- 
 Serve as a contributor within our implementation delivery team to develop a solution proposal and execution plan that includes scope, assumptions, implementation plan, and technology solution options to meet project goals as well as longer term needs   
- 
 Provide leadership and technical guidance in supply chain management and proactively identifies risks and mitigation plans within respective functional area    
- 
 Lead the design, configuration, and testing of core solu tions modules   
- 
 Lead data migration conversations, work with the technical team to execute data migrations, and test data migrations for accuracy   
- 
 Convert client requirements to functional specs and design documents; ensure the accuracy of requirements and design documents   
- 
 Maintain knowledge of third-party software vendors to leverage complementary offerings and effectively compare solutions.     
- 
 Communicate complex topics regarding solutions and related projects to audiences both with and without deep technical skills   
- 
 Perform demonstrations of D365 SCM to clients as part of project execution as part of our proof of concept, Joint Process Design methodology   
- 
 Leverage knowledge and experience to find and encourage win-win solutions with team members and clients   
- 
 Organize tasks and projects efficiently and set clear goals to ensure timely completion   
- 
 Make effective decisions and recommendations for Stoneridge Software and our clients’ best interests   
- 
 Deliver high-quality work within established deadlines, ensuring accuracy and attention to detail   
- 
 Prioritize self-development by attending training or self-learning to enhance skills and expertise   
- 
 Instill trust through honesty, integrity, and respect, modeling the organization’s values and vision
Preferred Qualifications
- 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology , Business, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent work experience   
- 
 8+ years of consulting experience   
- 
 5+ Years leading D365 F&O implementations   
- 
 8+ years of software experience in business-to-business environment   
- 
 Experience working within the following D365 F&O modules: Advanced Warehouse / Warehouse Management, Inventory Management, Inventory Valuation and Closing, Logistics, Product Information Management, Product Returns and/or Supply Chain   
- 
 Proven ability to create innovative solutions to solve complex business requirements, and streamline/automate business processes   
- 
 Ability to communicate effectively in both spoken and written English    
- 
 Exhibits Stoneridge Software’s Core Values of Integrity , Technical Excellence , Tenacity, Client Centric , and Enjoy your Work    
 *Year s  of experience  are not required to  be consecutive

Work Location: This position is available remotely in the United States and Canada. 
 Travel Required :  Incumbent is expected to travel across the United States and Canada for industry events and, as needed, for onsite client, project, delivery, or in‑person collaboration at company office locations in Fargo, ND and Minneapolis, MN. Travel is expected to be up to 25% of the role.  
 Visa Sponsorship Information: Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. or Canada.
Compensation
Our philosophy is to provide compensation that is Competitive, Equitable, and Driven by Performance.  Various factors impact our pay ranges including market conditions and national salary data. To determine competitive salaries within this range we consider candidates skills, qualifications, and experience. These are national ranges, inclusive of bonus opportunities and could represent multiple role levels. 
 US (USD): $ 161,000-$203,600 
 Canada (CAD): C$143,300-$177,300 
 Stoneridge reserves the right to hire any individual without legal or financial obligation on unwanted solicitations. No agency emails, calls, or solicitations are accepted without a valid agreement.

title: Lead Advisor
body:
Ready to make a meaningful impact? 
 At Brighton Jones, we’re a purpose-driven, client-focused team committed to helping individuals live richer lives. As one of the largest RIAs in the nation, we’ve built a culture of continuous growth, collaboration, and community—recognized with 15 consecutive “Best Places to Work” awards including Inc.com’s 2025 list, as well as national honors for community impact. 
 We lead the industry in aligning wealth, passion, and purpose to help our clients thrive. With over $30 billion in assets under advisement, 300+ teammates nationwide, and a dynamic, team-based approach, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for driven, curious individuals to join our #OneTeam.  
 We're seeking our next OpenPlan Advisor, a key role in our emerging business line at Brighton Jones dedicated to providing personalized financial empowerment. We focus on supporting clients early in their wealth journey, partnering with leading companies and individuals to offer holistic wealth management services. OpenPlan Advisors work closely with clients to understand their unique goals and challenges, creating and updating their Foundational Plan. They also collaborate with key decision makers in organizations to deliver a comprehensive retirement plan offering, including personalized financial advisory for employees. This role is ideal for a natural problem solver passionate about helping others, who thrives in a fast-paced, learning-oriented environment. 
 Take our Values in Action Self-Assessment to see how our values align!
Your Role:
- Work directly with clients to help them design, implement and manage the financial plan that supports their “Life Plan”
- Oversee assigned clients and conduct regular dialogue via email and video conference to discuss the client’s investment objectives, goals, needs, and expectations
- Educate and consult with clients on creating an investment philosophy, understanding market/portfolio performance, and other financial matters
- Be able to communicate your understanding of global financial markets as well as current events and other topical issues and how they relate to the client’s investment strategy relative to Brighton Jones’ investment philosophy and approach
- Organize and input client data into the CRM (Salesforce) and financial planning software (RightCapital); manage data accuracy and integrity and keep records current
- Generate referrals from existing clients and on your own
- Drive the sales process with prospective clients to support ongoing growth, including making referrals to the Personal CFO team for clients with increased wealth complexity
- Support the Brighton Jones mission by using objectivity, creativity, and passion to help our clients, colleagues, and community members “live richer lives”
- Provide teammates with timely, candid, and constructive performance feedback
- Assist with ad-hoc projects around client support or team support
Your Experience:
- 4+ years of direct client advising experience
- Undergraduate degree and CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ (CFP®) designation required
- High level of technical expertise in estate planning, tax, retirement, insurance, investment, and cash flow/capital needs planning analysis
- Familiarity and experience with executive compensation packages (including RSUs, ISOs, NSOs, ESOPs, ESPP plans, etc) and experience assisting clients with identifying planning strategies and execution methods
- Familiarity with RightCapital and Salesforce CRM (or similar software programs)
- Strong organizational skills, ability to manage heavy workloads and projects, many on a time-sensitive basis, efficiently and effectively
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products (Word, Excel, Windows) required; expected to learn other position-related systems on the job
- Unquestioned commitment to integrity in personal and professional activities
- Highly motivated to learn and grow and with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment independently
- Excellent oral and written communications skills, able to interact with clients and project a professional, capable image in action and appearance
- This is a full-time/exempt status position
- This role is fully remote, though in-office time is highly encouraged.

title: Structural Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
body:
About the Opportunity
 Walker Consultants is seeking a Structural Engineering Intern to join our Minneapolis office for Summer 2027. This internship provides an opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and consultants on a variety of structural design, restoration, forensic, and building envelope projects.
 As part of our Minneapolis team, you will gain hands-on experience supporting project development from investigation and design through construction administration and field observation. You'll collaborate with engineers and project managers, apply engineering concepts to real-world projects, and develop technical skills that will help lay the foundation for a successful career in structural engineering. The Minneapolis office serves clients throughout the Upper Midwest and offers exposure to a wide range of building and infrastructure projects.
 What You'll Do
- Work directly with Project Engineers and Project Managers to support project design and documentation.
- Prepare and revise structural drawings, details, calculations, and technical reports.
- Utilize BIM technology (Revit) to develop and coordinate 3D building models.
- Perform structural design calculations and detailing for building structures, foundations, and retaining systems.
- Interpret and apply building codes, industry standards, and project requirements.
- Assist with field investigations, site visits, condition assessments, and construction observations.
- Review construction documents, shop drawings, and project submittals.
- Participate in project coordination meetings and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
- Support the preparation of engineering reports, calculations, and other project deliverables.
- Perform other duties as assigned.
 What You Bring
 Required Qualifications
- Actively pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Architectural/Engineering Technology.
- 0-5 years of previous structural design experience.
- Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
- Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
- Reliable access to a personal vehicle is required for the duration of employment.
 Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge and experience using Revit.
- Understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, and AutoCAD.
- Coursework or experience in Structural Analysis, Reinforced Concrete, Steel Design, or Foundation Design.
- Interest in restoration, forensic investigations, and building envelope consulting.
- Willingness to travel locally for project site visits and fieldwork.

 Stanley Consultants is seeking a Principal Control Systems Engineer to serve as a technical specialist and leader with deep expertise in process instrumentation and control systems. This role requires comprehensive understanding of advanced control theories, concepts, and principles to lead complex projects and solve unique technical challenges. The Principal Engineer will provide strategic direction for control systems design across power plants, microgrid control systems, municipal water/wastewater systems, industrial automation systems, and combined heat and power (CHP) systems for utilities, universities, campuses, and industrial facilities.
What You Will Be Doing:
Key Responsibilities 
 Technical Leadership & Design: 
- Interpret, organize, execute, and coordinate complex control systems engineering assignments, often dealing with unique problems that have significant project impact
- Lead technical responsibility for evaluation of existing systems and design of plant control and instrumentation systems for diverse industrial applications including Distributed Control Systems (DCS) and Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)
- Develop innovative concepts and approaches for control system architectures and recommend significant design changes to enhance project outcomes and efficiency
- Determine client requirements and develop comprehensive technical documents including reports, specifications, drawings, instructions, P&IDs, I/O lists, instrument data sheets, cable schedules, procurement specifications, logic and SAMA diagrams
- Evaluate the need for control system design changes and make appropriate recommendations based on technical analysis and project requirements
- Sign and seal control systems engineering plans, documents, and reports in accordance with professional standards and regulatory requirements
- Maintain adherence to Stanley Consultants quality assurance and quality control standards
 Client Relations & Project Management: 
- Serve as primary technical controls liaison with clients on projects, ensuring clear communication and coordination of control systems efforts to meet project objectives and client expectations
- Plan, organize, and recommend programs and resources to meet objectives of the control systems technical organization
- Participate in bid evaluation, construction support, and work closely with site engineering groups during installation and commissioning of designed control systems
- Consult with construction personnel to discuss design constructability related to field conditions, sequencing, and scheduling of construction activities
- Lead client communications and attend both onsite and offsite meetings to discuss project specifics, technical requirements, and system performance
 Business Development & Strategic Planning: 
- Assist in pricing, estimating, and scoping for proposed control systems projects to ensure competitive positioning aligned with market demands and company capabilities
- Development of comprehensive proposal documents for new projects including detailed scope of work and accurate fee estimating
- Identify opportunities for enhanced control system solutions that provide value to clients and expand business opportunities
Required Qualifications:
Qualifications: 
- Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from an ABET accredited university
- Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) required
- Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in control systems engineering
- Extensive experience with Distributed Control Systems (DCS) and Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) design, implementation, and commissioning
- Demonstrated track record of successfully leading complex control systems projects from concept through commissioning
- Experience with municipal, industrial, and power generation control systems applications
 Technical Competencies: 
- Deep understanding of process instrumentation, control theory, and automation principles
- Proficiency with control system design software, PLC/DCS programming platforms, and HMI/SCADA systems
- Comprehensive knowledge of industry standards including ISA, IEC, NFPA, and NEC as applicable to control systems
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for addressing unique technical challenges
- Demonstrated understanding of Stanley Consultants project management procedures
 Professional Skills: 
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
- Strong leadership capabilities with experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams
- Proven ability to build and maintain client relationships
- Effective at working collaboratively in team environments while also providing independent technical leadership
- Strong business acumen including proposal development, cost estimating, and strategic planning

title: Assistant Plant Manager
body:
Summary:   We are a high-growth, fast-moving small functional beverage company, scaling internal operations and driving innovation at our new expanded plant location.  To support the growth, SGSY recently expanded into a single 70,000 sq ft plant with vertically integrated operations.  
 We are seeking an Assistant Plant Manager to improve operational excellence with safe, efficient and reliable performance.   This role is responsible for overseeing day-to-day production operations and plant technical operations, including maintenance programs and capital projects.  This role leads a team of 6 direct reports (5 Maintenance Technicians and the Production Team Leader) and reports to the Director of Operations, who also oversees Supply Chain, Warehousing, and FSQ.
 SO GOOD SO YOU VALUES: 
 At So Good So You, it is our mission to care for our bodies and the planet. We also believe that work should be enjoyable. We have a fun, high-performance environment rooted in doing more good together , celebrating curiosity , and focusing on what matters . This value set is the secret behind our incredible growth, amazing team, and why the future looks even brighter.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
You’ll partner closely with the Director of Operations and the Production Team Leader to own day-to-day production execution, while also owning the engineering, maintenance, and technical execution of the facility.
- 
 Provide operational leadership across production and technical functions, ensuring effective coordination, problem solving and execution against safety, quality, productivity and reliability goals.
- 
 Own day-to-day production operations, working hands-on alongside the Production Team Leader on the floor to ensure schedules, staffing, and quality standards are met each shift.
- 
 Drive production KPIs, including throughput, yield, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), and downtime, using data to identify and close performance gaps.
- 
 Directly lead the Production Team Leader, who in turn leads the production line workforce, while also overseeing the 5-person Maintenance Technician team.
- 
 Lead plant engineering and maintenance activities, including preventative and corrective maintenance programs.
- 
 Oversee and execute capital projects, including equipment upgrades, line expansions, and vendor coordination.
- 
 Establish and manage the parts crib infrastructure, ensuring the right parts are available at the right time and at the lowest possible cost. 
- 
 Ensure full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, and regulatory standards, and champion continuous improvement in these areas.
- 
 Oversee technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis of equipment and process issues to support consistent production performance.
- 
 Support the plant in driving lean initiatives such as: 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, and related methodologies.
- 
 Coach, mentor, and develop team members; foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
WHO YOU ARE:
- 
 Hands-on technical leader who thrives in fast-moving manufacturing environments and enjoys solving complex operational challenges.
- 
 Strong problem solver who can quickly diagnose equipment or process issues and implement practical, sustainable solutions.
- 
 Collaborative partner who works effectively with operations leaders, engineers, and production teams to improve plant performance.
- 
 Builder mindset with the ability to scale systems, processes, and infrastructure as the plant grows.
- 
 Calm under pressure and comfortable balancing day-to-day technical needs with longer-term capital planning and improvement initiatives.
- 
 Comfortable being hands-on on the plant floor across both production and maintenance disciplines, while also leading leaders and developing a Production Team Leader.
QUALIFICATIONS:
Required Qualifications
- 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and manufacturing leadership experience will be considered
- 
 6-7 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, ideally in food, beverage, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) production environments
- 
 Proven experience leading teams and, ideally, leading leaders (managing a supervisor or team lead who has their own direct reports)
- 
 Demonstrated experience managing production KPIs such as throughput, yield, OEE, and downtime
- 
 Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing 
- 
 Strong experience with equipment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement
- 
 Experience leading capital projects, equipment installations, or facility upgrades
 Preferred Qualifications
- 
 Experience in food, beverage, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing
- 
 Experience supporting plant startups, new line installations, or rapid production scaling
- 
 Experience implementing preventative or predictive maintenance systems
- 
 Familiarity with High Pressure Processing, high speed PET bottling, automation, controls systems and process engineering improvements
- 
 Spanish language proficiency is a strong plus.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
In accordance with Minnesota's Pay Transparency Law (effective January 1, 2025), the salary range for this position is $115,000 - $135,000 annually.
 We believe taking care of our people is part of doing things For the Love of Body and Planet™, so we back that up with:
-

-

-

-

-

-

title: Cost and Inventory Accountant
body:

 Founded in 2014 in Minneapolis, So Good So You is a leading brand of premium plant-based functional beverages in the exciting natural and better-for-you food and beverage industry. SGSY is the fastest-growing brand in functional beverages and the #1 juice shot brand, featured in 2025 for the sixth consecutive year on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing privately held companies in the US, as well as on Bain's list of Insurgent Brands for the last two years. Our industry-leading premium probiotic wellness shots are carried in over 14,000 locations across all 50 states. This thriving category is still developing, and there is a ton of continued upside as we accelerate consumer penetration — momentum further supported by our recent acquisition by Bansk, a leading private equity firm, which brings an exciting ambition for growth along with the resources we need to achieve it.
 As a mission-driven brand that does all things For the Love of Body and Planet™, SGSY became a B Corp in early 2023, officially codifying its commitment to optimizing the brand's social and environmental impact. A WBENC-certified majority female-owned business, SGSY advocates for social justice and closing the opportunity gap within minority communities. The current workforce is 67% female and 46% BIPOC, with 50% of managers across all levels being female. Additionally, SGSY actively seeks to hire and support the career growth of minority, BIPOC, and diversity candidates.
The Role

 Follows through and executes consistently

is $70,000 - $90,000, with hired candidates potentially eligible for an annual bonus on top of base.

body:

 As a mission-driven brand that does all things For the Love of Body and Planet™, SGSY became a B Corp in early 2023, officially codifying its commitment to optimizing the brand's social and environmental impact. Additionally, SGSY actively seeks to hire and support the career growth of minority, BIPOC, and diversity candidates.
The Role
So Good So You is looking for a Senior Manager, Brand Activation to help us build a brand people don’t just buy, but genuinely want to be part of.
 Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you’ll help turn our broader brand vision into ideas, experiences, and moments that will make So Good So You more relevant in people’s lives. You’ll  lead our work across social, creators and influencers, partnerships, experiential, community, and other ways we engage with consumers. Working closely with Brand and Creative, you’ll take the broader brand strategy and priorities and turn them into strong plans across the areas you lead, then bring together the right internal team members and external partners to take those plans from idea through execution.
 This role is for someone who has helped build modern, social-first brands and knows what makes people pay attention. You understand social deeply, have a strong point of view on what’s interesting, and know how to turn instinct into ideas that are right for the brand. You’ll set clear direction for your team and partners, help make the work better, and step into it yourself when needed.
 We’re growing quickly and have big ambitions for where So Good So You can go. We’re looking for someone who wants to help us get there.
What You’ll Do
- 
 Help build a brand people want to be part of, turning broader brand strategy into social, creator, influencers, partnerships, experiential, and community building programs that build awareness, relevance, and connection with consumers
- 
 Turn strategy into ideas people care about, developing plans, programs, and experiences that bring So Good So You to life, get people’s attention, and give them a reason to talk about and share the brand
- 
 Build our community and grow the conversation around So Good So You, creating meaningful ways for people to discover us, connect with us, and feel part of what we’re building
- 
 Find opportunities others might miss. Stay close to what’s happening across social, creators, culture, and consumer behavior. Bring us the creator we should know, the partnership we should make, the place we should show up, the conversation we should join, or the idea we haven’t thought of yet
- 
 Connect the work across the areas you lead, making sure social, creators, partnerships, community, and real-world experiences build on one another rather than becoming a collection of one-off tactics
- 
 Lead and develop your team, setting clear priorities and a high bar, giving meaningful feedback, creating accountability, and helping people grow
- 
 Bring together the right people to make the work happen, whether that’s your team, an agency, a creator, a partner, a specialist, or you stepping in yourself. Give clear direction, keep the work moving, and hold everyone accountable for delivering
- 
 Know what’s working and make it better, setting clear goals, learning from performance and consumer feedback, and using those learnings to make smarter decisions about what we do next
Who You Are
- 
 You know what makes a brand interesting. You’re a strong storyteller with great instincts for the ideas, experiences, and details that make people pay attention and want to know more
- 
 Social is second nature to you. You know the platforms, creators, communities, trends, and conversations shaping how people discover and connect with brands and what they care about. You know what is gaining momentum and what actually has a place in the brand
- 
 You have strong judgment. You know being relevant isn’t about chasing every trend. You can tell the difference between something that’s right for the brand and something that’s simply having a moment
- 
 You’ve helped build a brand people want to pay attention to. You can point to ideas, programs, partnerships, experiences, or communities that changed how people saw or engaged with a brand
- 
 You know how to turn direction into action. You can take a strategy or brief, figure out what it means for the areas you lead, and move the work forward 
- 
 You think beyond the usual playbook. You look for what we could do differently, where we could show up unexpectedly, and what we haven’t tried yet
- 
 You’re a strong people leader and collaborator. You set a high bar, give clear feedback, bring out the best in your team, and partners
- 
 You create momentum. You bring ideas, take ownership, push work forward, and raise the bar along the way
- 
 You care about results. You want to know what worked, what didn’t, and what we should do differently next time
Required Qualifications
- 
 5+ years of experience in brand activation, integrated marketing, social, influencer/creator, community, experiential, partnership, integrated, or consumer marketing, either brand-side or agency-side, ideally working with consumer brands
- 
 A track record of building modern, social-first consumer brands, with examples of work that drove attention, conversation, engagement, and brand relevance
- 
 Significant experience with social media and a strong understanding of social platforms, creators, trends, communities, and how brands earn attention
- 
 Experience working across multiple areas such as social, influencer/creator, partnerships, experiential, and community, with a strong understanding of how they can work together
- 
 Experience taking a brand strategy or brief, turning it into a clear plan, and leading the work from idea through execution
- 
 Experience managing and developing people, as well as leading agencies, contractors, creators, and other external partners
- 
 Strong creative judgment and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain an idea, give direction, and bring people along

title: Senior Associate, Tax
body:
Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything.  Aprio has 40 U.S. office locations, as well as international office locations and more than 3,200 team members that speak 60+ languages across the globe.  By bringing together proven expertise, deep understanding, and strategic foresight for fast-growing industries, Aprio ensures clients are prepared for wherever life or business may take them. Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio. 
 Aprio is seeking a Senior Tax Associate to join our growing Enterprise Tax team, serving middle-market clients across technology, manufacturing, and distribution industries.
 We are looking for someone with experience across corporations, partnerships, flow-through entities, and individual returns. Like variety? This role offers broad exposure to compliance, consulting, multistate tax, and M&A-related projects, allowing you to develop well-rounded technical expertise while working with middle-market businesses ranging from closely held companies to larger, more complex organizations. You'll collaborate closely with tax, assurance, and advisory professionals firmwide, build meaningful client relationships, and gain increasing responsibility as you progress toward Manager and beyond.
- Take ownership of engagements from planning through completion
- Build meaningful client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor
- Collaborate with an experienced team that is investing in technology, automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern tax delivery processes
- Gain exposure to engagement review, staff development, and increasing leadership responsibilities as you progress toward Manager and beyond
- Work closely with partners and industry leaders who are committed to mentoring and developing future leaders within the practice
- Grow your career within a nationally recognized advisory and accounting firm
Responsibilities:
As a Senior Tax Associate, your typical day may include:
- Preparing and reviewing federal and state tax returns, with a primary focus on partnerships and other flow-through entities
- Preparing and reviewing federal and state tax returns for corporations, partnerships, S corporations, and individuals
- Reviewing workpapers, trial balances, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance
- Taking ownership of assigned client engagements and helping drive projects through timely completion
- Researching tax issues and identifying opportunities to support client objectives and planning strategies
- Collaborating directly with clients to gather information, answer questions, and provide responsive service
- Responding to review comments, resolving technical issues, and incorporating feedback efficiently
- Reviewing work prepared by junior staff and providing coaching, guidance, and constructive feedback
- Leveraging tax technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and service delivery
- Working closely with Managers, Directors, and Partners to deliver high-quality tax solutions and support client growth initiatives
- Supporting multistate tax and SALT engagements
- Assisting with consulting and M&A-related projects
Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting
- 2-5 years of public accounting tax experience
- Experience preparing tax returns for corporations, partnerships, S corporations, and individuals,
- Experience reviewing workpapers and responding to review notes
- Strong accounting fundamentals and understanding of CPA firm operations
- Ability to manage multiple engagements successfully
- Solid understanding of accounting fundamentals and CPA firm operations
- Experience working directly with clients and building trusted relationships
- Comfort working with tax technology, automation tools, and evolving AI-enabled solutions
- Ability to collaborate effectively with both onshore and offshore teams
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- CPA or EA designation (preferred)
