title: Shift Leader
body:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

At Insomnia Cookies, our Shift Leaders are the leaders in action. As the person leading the shift, you'll work side-by-side with your Cookie Crew to deliver warm, delicious cookies and an exceptional guest experience. From baking and packing orders to coaching teammates and keeping the bakery running smoothly, you'll lead by example every shift.
 If you enjoy fast-paced environments, love working with people, and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, this is the role for you.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO: 
 As the leader on duty, you will:
- Lead bakery operations during your shift, ensuring an exceptional guest experience from start to finish.
- Bake, package, and prepare orders while providing exceptional guest service.
- Coach and motivate Cookie Crew members, providing direction, feedback, and support throughout the shift.
- Prioritize and delegate tasks to keep operations running efficiently and meet guest demand.
- Help maintain our standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and speed of service.
- Handle cash management, register accountability, and deposits.
- Communicate important updates and partner with store leadership to keep the bakery operating at its best.
- Jump in wherever needed to help your team succeed.

QUALIFICATIONS 
- 1+ year of experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer-focused environment
- Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
- Positive attitude with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences
- Must be 18 years of age or older
- Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
- Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
 Physical Requirements 
 This position regularly requires the ability to:
- Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
- Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
- Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
- Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
- Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
- Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
- Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
- Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
- Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.
 Work Environment 
 This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.
 Schedule Expectations 
 Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

As a Shift Leader, you are the captain of our bakery day or night! You understand what it takes to “Own the Night” (and beyond), by predicting the flow of business during a successful shift. Your hands-on leadership style should not only include building orders, suggestive selling, baking, and interacting with customers – it will also mean taking pride in knowing that your prowess as a leading Insomniac attributes to a productive and fun night for your store!
Check out some of our content vids to learn more!
Who We Are!
Insomnia Cookies Timeline
Core Values
SOME OUR SWEET SHIFT LEADER PERKS:
•         Flexible part-time work schedules
•         Pay-on-Demand (no longer do you have to wait until the end of the week. Get paid daily for your total shift earnings from the day before!)
•         Paid vacation and sick time off
•         Interactive training & mentorship
•         Pet insurance for your furry loved ones
•         Job stability with a rapidly growing and reputable company
•         Achievable growth/promotion opportunities
•         You get to work in a fun, exciting team environment
•         Employee discount and FREE cookies with every shift!
WHAT WILL I DO AS A SHIFT LEADER?
•         Provide incredible customer service and quality products to all of our guests throughout their experience within our bakeries
•         Support store leadership by maintaining operations during your shift, communicating pertinent information, monitoring production efficiency, holding the team accountable to company standards and procedures, and assisting in the training and coaching of team members
•         Prioritize and delegate tasks for baking, cashiering, packaging, and cleaning while leading the cookie crew team
•         Support and work alongside the Cookie Crew
•         Provide a safe, clean, working environment for our guests and staff and adhere to safe food handling practices
•         Manage cash handling and deposits
DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:
•         At least 1 year of working experience in a customer service focused role
•         Point of Sales systems experience
•         Outstanding communication, time management, and people skills
•         Outgoing/friendly/patient
•         Detail focused and results-oriented
•         Ability to lead-by-example and motivate others
•         Ability to lift up to 40 lbs.
•         Legally eligible to work in the United States
•         Must be 18 years or older to be employed

At Insomnia Cookies, our Shift Leaders are the leaders in action. As the person leading the shift, you'll work side-by-side with your Cookie Crew to deliver warm, delicious cookies and an exceptional guest experience. From baking and packing orders to coaching teammates and keeping the bakery running smoothly, you'll lead by example every shift.
 If you enjoy fast-paced environments, love working with people, and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, this is the role for you.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO: 
 As the leader on duty, you will:
- Lead bakery operations during your shift, ensuring an exceptional guest experience from start to finish.
- Bake, package, and prepare orders while providing exceptional guest service.
- Coach and motivate Cookie Crew members, providing direction, feedback, and support throughout the shift.
- Prioritize and delegate tasks to keep operations running efficiently and meet guest demand.
- Help maintain our standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and speed of service.
- Handle cash management, register accountability, and deposits.
- Communicate important updates and partner with store leadership to keep the bakery operating at its best.
- Jump in wherever needed to help your team succeed.

QUALIFICATIONS 
- 1+ year of experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer-focused environment
- Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
- Positive attitude with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences
- Must be 18 years of age or older
- Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location
- Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
 Physical Requirements 
 This position regularly requires the ability to:
- Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift).
- Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
- Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
- Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
- Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system.
- Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
- Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
- Read order screens, recipes, and safety information.
- Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment.
 Work Environment 
 This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.
 Schedule Expectations 
 Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location.

title: Store Operations Manager (GM)
body:
Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!

ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 As a Bakery Operations Manager at Insomnia Cookies , you’re not just managing a bakery.  You’re building a team, creating the experience our guests come back for and owning the results of your business.
 You’re the leader, setting the standard for your team, your guests, your cookies, and your results. You’ll hire and develop great people, create an environment where they can thrive, deliver an exceptional guest experience, and drive the sales and operational results your bakery is expected to achieve.
 This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll be actively engaged in the day-to-day operation, know your business, understand what drives performance, and take action to hit your sales targets and improve results. That means coaching and developing your team, leading through busy late-night rushes, connecting with guests, and finding new ways to grow your business.
 If you love developing people, driving results, delivering great experiences, and making things happen in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in. And as Insomnia grows, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to grow with us.
 WHAT YOU’LL DO: 
 Operational Execution 
- Own the day-to-day operation of your bakery, ensuring every shift is staffed, prepared, and set up for success.
- Maintain high standards for cookie quality, speed, accuracy, cleanliness, food safety, and overall bakery execution.
- Own scheduling and labor execution, balancing the needs of your team with the needs of the business.
- Manage ordering, inventory accuracy, product rotation, shrink, and other bakery controls.
- Maintain strong operational routines and quickly address gaps when standards aren’t being met.
 Guest Experience 
- Bring our Always Warm promise to life, creating a bakery experience that feels welcoming, energetic, and unmistakably Insomnia.
- Set the standard for genuine hospitality and coach your team to deliver friendly, fast, and memorable service on every shift.
- Stay close to the guest experience, recognize opportunities to make it better, and take action when we miss the mark.
 Talent & Team Development 
- Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a strong team of Shift Leaders, Cookie Crew, and Delivery Drivers.
- Create a culture where expectations are clear, great performance is recognized, and team members are supported and held accountable.
- Provide consistent coaching and real-time feedback that helps your people grow and get better.
- Develop Shift Leaders who can confidently lead great shifts, coach their teams, and solve problems.
- Build a strong talent pipeline and create opportunities for team members to grow their careers with Insomnia.
 Leadership & Ownership 
- Take ownership of your bakery’s performance, knowing your sales and key performance measures and taking action to achieve your goals.
- Understand what drives your business, identify opportunities, and turn them into action.
- Lead with urgency, accountability, and consistency, especially during peak and late-night shifts.
- Partner with your District Manager and field leadership to solve problems and continuously improve your bakery.
- Build connections in your local community and execute local marketing activities that drive awareness, traffic, and sales.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: 
- 3+ years of management or leadership experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, or another fast-paced customer-facing environment.
- Availability to work a schedule that reflects the needs of the bakery, including 2–3 mid-to-late shifts during the latter part of the week (Thursday–Sunday). 
- A hands-on, player-coach leadership style and willingness to jump in wherever your team and business need you.
- A track record of hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining great teams.
- A natural sense of hospitality and commitment to delivering an exceptional guest experience.
- Strong business acumen and the ability to understand performance, set priorities, and turn goals into action.
- Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
- Comfort learning and using restaurant/retail technology and business systems.
- Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location.
- Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
 Physical Requirements 
 This is a hands-on bakery leadership role. This position regularly requires the ability to:
- Stand and walk for extended periods of time, including up to 8 hours during a shift.
- Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift.
- Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly.
- Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance.
- Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, technology, and point-of-sale systems.
- Safely operate bakery and kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures.
- Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units.
- Read order screens, reports, recipes, schedules, and safety information.
- Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions.
- Ability to work nights and weekends
 Work Environment 
 This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business.
 Bakery Operations Managers are expected to be actively engaged in bakery operations and able to perform the essential duties of bakery team members when needed.
 Schedule Expectations 
 Our business comes alive in the evenings and late into the night. Bakery Operations Managers are expected to work a schedule that reflects the needs of their bakery including weekends and holidays as business needs require.  Bakery Operations Managers work a minimum of 45 hours per week.
 As the leader of the bakery, schedule flexibility is important, particularly during peak business periods, staffing needs, and other times when leadership presence is needed.
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 Reasonable Accommodation 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.
 Additional Information 
 Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law.
 Ready to Join? 
 We’re looking for leaders who bring great energy, take ownership, develop great teams, and love making someone’s day a little sweeter.
 When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy: 
- Competitive base pay plus quarterly performance bonus opportunity 
- Monthly Cell Phone Stipend 
- Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!) 
- Employee discount (free cookies!) 
- Career development and advancement opportunities as Insomnia continues to grow 
- Comprehensive benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) including 401k company match that begin 30-days after employment 
 If you’re ready to lead from the front, grow your career, and help create warm moments one cookie at a time, we’d love to have you join the Insomnia Cookies family.

title: AI Research Internship
body:
Team Description: 
 Kitware is a leader in cutting-edge research and algorithm development for artificial intelligence (AI), including automated image, video, text, and multimodal analysis. Our solutions embracing AI add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We have developed a deep understanding in extracting useful, actionable information from multiple data sources like images, video, metadata, audio, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance AI, computer vision, and other related fields through research and development and collaborative projects that can contribute to our open source software platforms, such as XAITK , NRTK , and ALIGN .  
 About the Projects: 
 The AI Research interns will be able to explore their own ideas to address challenging real-world AI problems. They will be encouraged to publish the results of their work in academic papers submitted to premier conferences. We consider the work that we do on our government contracts as one of the ways that we give back to the community. We partner with premier government R&D agencies such as DARPA, IARPA, AFRL, NVESD, NOAA, and other branches of the US Government on a range of efforts, including prime contracts, SBIRs, and STTRs. In addition, we provide commercial services to companies ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Kitware employs an open source business model to foster extended, collaborative communities and to provide effective, flexible, and high-quality technical solutions.
In This Position You Will: 
- 
 Be part of Kitware's overall mission of positive social impact through work in areas such as environmental monitoring, national and global security, ethical and responsible AI, open science, scientific computing, and medical computing. 
- 
 Develop robust solutions in the various areas of AI, including Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision Language Models (VLMs), Foundation Models, etc.
- 
 Develop algorithms to solve interesting, challenging technical problems: object detection, classification, and tracking; video/image understanding and search; 3D reconstruction from aerial imagery; reasoning and alignment in decision-making; threat detection and decision alignment in cybersecurity; and many more.
Required Qualifications: 
- 
 Ph.D. students in Computer Science or a related AI field.
- 
 Knowledge and experience in computer vision, foundation models, LLMs, machine learning, audio processing, or related areas.
- 
 Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, Tensorflow, or other related tools. 
- 
 Candidates should include a list of publications as part of their resume/CV.
- 
 Due to contractual requirements, only U.S. citizens will be considered for this position.
- 
 This is an on-site position with the expectation of 5 days/week in office.
Preferred Qualifications: 
- 
 Experience with multiple large multimodal AI models, including image, text, and speech modalities.
- 
 Publication history and desire to publish in premier academic conferences like CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP, AAAI, ICML, NeurIPS, etc.
- 
 Experience and interest in contributing to open source software community projects.

title: Accounting Manager
body:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.   
 With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.   
 Position Summary:
 Perforce Software is looking for an Accounting Manager to lead a team through a period of rapid growth and international expansion. Specific areas of responsibility will include managing the global monthly close process, maintaining the NetSuite general ledger system, integrating domestic and international acquisitions, and other general accounting functions.  This position will work closely with the Controller and the Vice President of Finance as well as other senior management to meet department and company goals.
Responsibilities: 
- Provide leadership and direction to the accounting team and encourage an attitude of continuous improvement in their day-to-day activities.
- Manage general ledger activities, including journal entry preparation/review related to variety of areas: fixed assets, debt, software capitalization, payroll, employee stock, accounts receivable, cash, and other close-related functions.
- Ensure account reconciliations are completed in a timely manner and are reviewed for accuracy and completeness.
- Apply technical research to accounting conclusions on an ad hoc basis to evaluate the application of US GAAP to support transactions and document accounting conclusions
- Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, accelerate the close, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and standardize processes.
Requirements: 
- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.
- Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and the ability to interpret and implement new accounting guidance in an increasingly complex international business environment.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills and can work effectively with people outside of the accounting function.
- Operational experience with a major accounting system (such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP etc.)
- Comfortable working in a fast paced, team-oriented environment.
- Strong people management and mentoring skills
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting and a CPA certification preferred
- Experience in documenting and improving existing systems and processes preferred
AI Fluency: 
Level 1: Basic AI User (Foundation) Uses approved AI tools to support daily work, writes basic prompts, and reviews outputs for accuracy while following security, privacy, and Responsible AI guidelines.

title: HR Business Partner
body:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.   
 With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.   
 Summary: 
 Perforce is seeking an HR Business Partner to serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to designated business leaders and their leadership team. This role sits at the intersection of people strategy and business strategy – the HRBP earns a seat at the leadership table by deeply understanding the business’s goals, metrics, and challenges, then translating that understanding into people solutions that move the business forward. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role for an HR professional who wants to be judged not just on HR execution, but on business impact.  
 Key Responsibilities:  
 Business Partnership:  
 Serve as the primary HR point of contact for assigned business leaders and their leadership teams, understanding their goals, KPIs, and challenges well enough to proactively bring solutions, not just respond to request. 
 Attend business team meetings regularly to build fluency in the business’s priorities, market pressures, and org dynamics. 
 Advise managers on org structure, role design, and workforce planning aligned to business priorities.  
 Actively collaborate with HRBPs, Generalists and COEs across functions and geographies, sharing insights and patterns seen in your business units.  
 Talent & Performance:  
 Guide leaders through performance management cycles, calibration, and talent reviews for their client group.  
 Partner with Talent Acquisition to align hiring plans with business growth and headcount needs. 
 Support succession planning and identification of high-potential talent within the client group. 
 Employee Relations and Compliance:  
 Manage employee relations matters – including investigations, coaching, and performance concerns – with sound judgement and appropriate escalation. 
 Ensure consistent application of HR policy and compliance with employment law across the business unit.  
 Apply hands-on employment law experience to navigate complex or high-risk employee relations situations. 
 Data and Insights:  
 Use people data (attrition, engagement survey results, headcount trends) to identify risks and opportunities within the client group and bring recommendations to leadership. 
 Translate engagement survey and exit interview themes into targeted action plans. 
 Apply AI tools to analyze people data and surface patterns faster (e.g. identifying attrition risk signals, summarizing engagement themes, or spotting trends across large business units).  
 Actively look for ways to incorporate AI into day-to-day HRBP work (data analysis, drafting, research, prep for leadership conversations) to work smarter.  
 Change and Culture:  
 Support change management for org changes, restructures, or growth within the business units. 
 Champion Perforce’s culture and values throughout the employee lifecycle for the business units.
Qualifications:
Required:  
- 5-8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in an HR Business Partner or generalist role supporting a client group directly.  
- Demonstrated ability to build credibility with business leaders – you can sit in a business review and contribute beyond the “HR update.” 
- Experience across the core HRBP toolkit: performance management, talent planning, employee relations, organizational design, and change management. 
- Strong data literacy: comfortable pulling and interpreting people data (attrition, engagement, headcount) to build a business case, not just report a metric. 
- Strong working knowledge of US employment law (FLSA, ADA, EEO, state-specific requirements) and demonstrated ability to apply it to real-time employee relations and policy decisions. 
- Comfort using AI tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude) for data analysis, drafting, or research in an HR context. 
- Excellent judgement and discretion in handling confidential and sensitive matters.  
 Preferred:  
- Experience supporting a technology or software business unit. 
- Prior experience in a global, fast-growth or matrixed organization. 
- Exposure to international employment practices (e.g. Canada, LATAM), given Perforce’s global employee footprint. 
- PHR, SHRM-CP or equivalent HR certification.
AI Fluency:
Level 2: Skilled Prompter (Advanced Foundation / Early Proficient) - Crafts effective, outcome‑oriented prompts, iterates to improve quality and speed, and validates AI outputs against business context and expectations.

title: Senior Accountant
body:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.   
 With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.   
 Position Summary:
 Perforce is looking for a Senior Accountant that will be a key member of a growing accounting team reporting to the Accounting Manager. The position will be responsible for accurate and timely month-end close and financial reporting and will work closely with management to analyze overall operational performance.  This will be a key position in the group and will be heavily relied upon to ensure accurate financial information is produced and appropriate accounting controls are followed.  The candidate must demonstrate the ability to use accounting knowledge and previous experience to add value and assist in meeting the department's objectives while working in a fast-paced, continually changing, and high-growth environment.
Responsibilities:
- Perform normal month-end closing procedures including journal entry preparation, reconciliations and variance analysis of expenses.
- Provide supporting schedules and analysis during the annual external audits.
- Assist with preparation and review of financial reports including balance sheets and income statements.
- Implement process and system improvements as needed by the business and ensure the appropriate accounting treatment is setup.
- Analyze financial data and resolve accounting discrepancies and irregularities.
- Other accounting duties as requested and/or assigned.
Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field from an accredited university.
- 3+ years of accounting experience at a staff accountant level or higher.
- CPA certification preferred.
- Strong analytical, verbal, written, and problem-solving skills.
- Computer experience with MS Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.
- Operational experience with a major accounting system (ex: NetSuite, Intacct, Oracle, SAP etc.)
- Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and have the ability to interpret and implement new accounting guidance in an increasingly complex business environment.
- Experience in documenting and improving existing systems and processes.
- Must have a proactive, positive attitude and be comfortable working in a fast paced, growth-oriented environment.
- Ability to act as a change agent and have experience in improving processes.
- High attention to detail and ability to manage/prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with other departments throughout the company.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team to foster a collaborative environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
body:
DEPARTMENT Engineering

LOCATION Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid)

TYPE Full time

REPORTS TO CTO




THE ROLE

Enterprises come to Blank Metal to get production AI live. That work is led by senior people who can sit across from a client's executives, diagnose the real problem, and then go build the thing that fixes it.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer you'll turn advisory conversations into shipped software, closing the gap between a promising demo and a system that runs in production, where most enterprise AI initiatives stall. You embed with a client, earn trust at the executive level, and stay hands-on from the first scoping session through the live deployment. You are equal parts technical leader and trusted advisor: you shape what gets built, you build it with a lean team of AI engineers, and you own whether it actually works in production.

The playbook for this practice is still being written, and you will write a lot of it: how we embed, how we prove value, and what we bring back from each engagement.

Forward deployed means what it says. Expect roughly 25 to 40% travel to client sites, heavier during kickoffs and go-lives. The rest of the time you work wherever you work best.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role with real ownership: you carry a small number of accounts deeply, and you are measured on outcomes clients can see.




WHAT YOU GET TO DO

Set the conditions

 - Partner with client executives to find the highest-value AI opportunity, then frame it in the client's own language

 - Lead scoping and proof of concept work that de-risks the build before a full engagement starts

 - Shape the technical approach and scope alongside our growth team; they own the close, you make sure what's promised is what can actually be built



Build it for real

 - Deploy alongside a lean team of AI engineers and own the architecture, the hard calls, and the code that ships

 - Deliver the concrete artifacts clients run in production: MCP servers, sub-agents, agent skills, and the pipelines around them

 - Work across the full stack and the model layer

 - Navigate real enterprise environments: the client's IT systems, security constraints, and the stakeholders who own them



Own the outcome

 - Stand behind results with observability and evals the client can check for themselves

 - Win over the people who use the system day to day; a deployment succeeds when they rely on it

 - Carry accounts end-to-end: some weeks are executive workshops, some weeks are debugging and agentic orchestration

 - Bring patterns back to the team so the next engagement starts further ahead




WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED

 - Typically 7+ years building and shipping software, including real time as a technical leader who executives actually trusted

 - A track record of owning production systems end-to-end, from first commit through live operation

 - You have shipped LLM-powered systems to production: agents, retrieval, evals, and the judgment to know when each is the wrong tool

 - Strong hands-on skills in Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, and comfort picking up whatever the client's stack demands

 - You have built or maintained eval frameworks that showed whether a system actually worked

 - You can hold your own with a CTO in the morning and be in the codebase in the afternoon

 - At home with ambiguity and a small team: you would rather figure it out than wait for a playbook

 - A straightforward communicator who explains hard technical calls in plain language

 - Low ego, high cooperation: you balance competing priorities with integrity and make the people around you better

 - You have been a founder, CTO, or first engineer building a product or startup and know what it costs to get something live.

 - Bonus: depth in healthcare or private equity, where much of our current work lives



If this role sounds like you but you don't check every box, apply anyway. We care more about what you've shipped than how the resume reads.




WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

 - Build AI that ships

 - Shape the practice: the way Blank Metal does forward deployment will carry your fingerprints

 - Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed

 - Outcome-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours

 - AI-native culture: you'll work with peers who deeply understand modern AI's potential and limits

 - Real collaboration: open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

This role pays a base salary commensurate with experience, plus a revenue-based variable comp structure tied to the accounts you carry: when your clients win and the company grows, your comp grows with it. We offer comprehensive health coverage, 401(k) with match, flexible time off, flexible work arrangements, and support for professional development.




ABOUT BLANK METAL

Blank Metal is an AI-native engineering company that partners with enterprises to deliver production AI fast. We blend strategic insight with hands-on execution, shipping high-impact systems that turn AI initiatives into measurable business results.

We're builders, not theorists. Our team of seasoned engineers, designers, and strategists work across industries to create AI applications that actually get used and make a difference.

body:
About Swoop:
Swoop Technologies has a mission to organize and make accessible the world’s military and critical infrastructure. We are building a distributed operating system, SwoopOS, that decomposes the world’s equipment into a distributed robotic embodiment upon which a new generation of distributed systems, autonomous systems, and agentic AI can be built and deployed using our SDK, Valhalla, and operated via our browser, Surf. Imagine the world’s equipment - consisting of the electrical grid, communications architectures, manufacturing facilities, and militaries as a trapped supply of inputs possessing the potential to ensure Western military advantage, sovereign control of economically competitive manufacturing capacity, or the creation of a grid that fosters energy dominance. Swoop is liberating these trapped assets, allowing them to contribute to the world’s future as a series of building blocks to be combined at the speed of software, limited by only the hard constraints of physics and the soft constraints of safety. That is what Swoop is building. Not in the data center or cloud or edge on-premise computing node. In the physical world. This is a hybrid position that requires someone based in Minneapolis/St. Paul OR Washington, DC who can work in-office 3+ days per week



Your Impact:

You get to build the web interface which exposes a highly distributed system (servers and edge devices) for real-time decision making and post processing analysis. Complex systems, and the data that transmits between them, has to be managed and surfaced to a user in a way that can be understood. You will build 2D and 3D animated visualizations of customer environments via graphs, geospatial maps, charts, and video/image playback, allow users to collaborate in real time as they interact with these visualizations, and contribute to an SDK that allows third parties to build applications for our system.



What You’ll Do:

 - Build scalable UI components and APIs to serve/search/visualize streaming and static data.

 - Contribute to libraries to visualize graphs of connected nodes utilizing modern web technologies, such as WebGL, that supports animation, user interactions, and a variety of algorithms to determine placement of nodes.

 - Utilize technologies to build performant 3D interactive renderings of objects, locations, and the globe.



You Should Have:

 - 4+ yrs of experience in frontend development using JavaScript and CSS

 - Well-versed in React

 - Competent in web performance testing and optimization

 - Understanding of basic software security standards

 - Active US Security clearance or ability and willingness to be sponsored for a US Security clearance



Nice to Haves:

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent technical experience 

 - Experience with NodeJS and server side frameworks, such as Express

 - Experience with WebGL, for both 2D and 3D renderings

 - Experience with Typescript or Tailwind CSS

The Playwright framework and migration from legacy tooling is already underway, we need someone who can pick up this work, drive it to completion, and continuously improve, scale, and optimize it as we go. Rather than manually writing test cases, you will build on the frameworks, feedback loops, and infrastructure that enable AI tools to generate, execute, and maintain automated tests at scale. You will work closely with our QA, Engineering, and Product teams to dramatically increase our automated regression coverage, accelerate delivery timelines, and reduce the risk of defects reaching production. Agentic AI is central to this role — you'll be hands-on with AI agents that generate, execute, and iterate on tests with minimal manual intervention.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Continue building and hands-on improve AI-driven test automation workflows using tools like Claude Code, where AI agents generate, execute, and iterate on Playwright tests with minimal human intervention. Your primary job is building and refining the system, not writing individual tests.

 - Continue evolving the existing Playwright test framework, refining patterns, page-object models, fixtures, and conventions to make them more efficient, scalable, and better optimized for AI-assisted test generation.

 - Build and improve tight feedback loops between local test execution, CI pipeline results, and merge request creation, so AI agents can run tests, interpret failures, fix issues, and resubmit with minimal manual intervention.

 - Drive the ongoing migration from Geb/Spock to Playwright to completion, using AI agents to accelerate conversion at scale while maintaining coverage continuity.

 - Integrate and continuously optimize Playwright test execution in GitLab CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates on every merge request and deployment. Optimize for fast feedback through parallelization and caching strategies.

 - Instrument tests with reporting on pass/fail trends, flakiness rates, and coverage gaps. Use this data to prioritize AI-driven test generation toward the highest-value uncovered areas.

 - Identify scenarios where end-to-end Playwright tests are not the right tool and build API-layer automation or contract tests for microservice boundaries instead.

 - Build hands-on automation for claims systems, contract testing, system integrations, and end-to-end user flow journeys.

title: Physical Therapist (PT)
body:
Physical Therapist (PT) - Home Health

 - Schedule: Full-time Monday–Friday + occasional weekends (as needed)

 - Location: Field Based

 - Compensation (Productivity Points):  Check Notion


WHO WE ARE:

Adaptive Home Health is building a higher-acuity, patient-centered, skilled home health model across Texas. Our mission is to dramatically improve patient access to home health care.

The PT role is a core part of that mission: you restore function, keep patients safe at home, and drive real outcomes.

We also build technology to support field clinicians. Our charting product reduces documentation burden, and our scheduling product (launching soon) will make routing and visit coordination easier — protecting your time.


WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Own the caseload as a case manager: you’re accountable for the patient’s therapy plan, progression, and outcomes — not just individual visits.

 - Complete comprehensive in-home assessments and deliver skilled PT visits.

 - Build and execute a clear plan of care: gait/balance, transfers, strengthening, functional mobility, home safety, fall prevention.

 - Set measurable goals, track objective progress, and adjust treatment quickly when patients stall.

 - Drive multidisciplinary coordination: communicate changes in condition, align on orders, and keep the care team moving.

 - Manage treatment and outcomes directly, including PTA supervision where appropriate.

 - Coach patients and caregivers with practical home programs that actually get done.

 - Document promptly and thoroughly in Homecare Homebase (HCHB) — defensible, efficient, and consistent.


WHY ADAPTIVE

 - Operations that back you up: You are supported by an experienced clinical and operational team so you can focus on patient care, not chasing logistics.

 - Clear productivity model with upside: You are paid per productivity point with an expectation of 30 points/week

 - Schedule flexibility: We build schedules to make field work sustainable, and we support smart routing and coordination so your day is predictable whenever possible.

 - Cutting-edge tech built for clinicians: Our charting tools are designed to reduce documentation burden, and our scheduling product (launching soon) will streamline visit coordination and reduce last-minute changes.

 - Mission-driven work: We are here to expand access to high-quality home health care, and we want therapists who take pride in raising the standard.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

 - Active Texas PT license (in good standing)

 - Strong clinical judgment and comfort working independently in the field

 - Comfortable escalating changes in condition to RN/MD and documenting rationale clearly

 - Strong communication and documentation

 - Reliable follow-through on orders, frequencies, and patient goals

 - Current driver’s license and comfort with daily travel across assigned territory

 - Able to carry/transport basic therapy equipment as needed

 - Competency in core home health PT scope
   
   - Safety-first mobility work: transfers, gait training, balance/fall prevention, assistive device recommendations
   
   - Strengthening, functional mobility, and home safety assessment/modification education
   
   - Patient/caregiver coaching with practical home programs

Nice-to-haves

 - Prior home health experience

 - Homecare Homebase (HCHB) experience (or similar home health EMR)

 - Deeper clinical experience in high-signal PT populations

 - Experience supervising/mentoring PTAs and collaborating on care plans

 - Strong organization and time management

title: Minneapolis Sales Leadership
body:
About Us

We are building a new kind of home health company — one that uses technology to remove the administrative burden that holds this industry back. Home health is a $140B market, but agencies lose nearly half their revenue to back-office overhead: scheduling, documentation, billing, prior authorizations. That waste drives up costs, burns out clinicians, and leaves millions of patients without care. We automate that work so our teams can focus on what matters — getting patients seen. The result: we operate with meaningfully better margins than traditional agencies, and we pass that advantage forward. We pay clinicians more, accept patients other agencies turn away, and scale faster because our operations aren't bottlenecked by paperwork. We've paired a world-class technology team (from Stanford, Harvard, Palantir, Google) with healthcare operators and advisors from the most successful healthcare companies to build a platform that handles the back office end-to-end — from intake and eligibility through charting, QA, and collections. We're already delivering care across multiple states and growing rapidly. Our mission is "any care, any where." We're starting with home health and expanding from there.

Every dollar in revenue we generate takes two dollars of waste out of the healthcare system. If we win, patients win.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Sales Leader to own a defined territory as a player-coach. You'll drive your own book of accounts while coaching and developing a small team of sales reps to grow the territory.

This role is for someone who's ready to step into sales leadership but still wants to stay close to the field. You'll partner directly with your Regional Sales Manager (RSM) to execute market strategy, build facility relationships, and develop your team.

You'll be responsible for:

 - Owning and growing a defined territory, with a focus on high-value referral sources

 - Leading as a player-coach: managing your own accounts while coaching 2–5 sales reps

 - Building facility relationships with discharge planners, case managers, and facility leadership

 - Developing your reps through ride-alongs, pipeline reviews, and structured coaching

 - Driving quarter-over-quarter admission growth, the primary measure of success in this role

This is a high-visibility role with a clear path to Regional Sales Manager as Adaptive scales nationally.

What You'll Do

1. Own your territory and drive admission growth

 - Execute a data-driven territory plan: prioritize high-value accounts, target whitespace, and win share from competitors

 - Manage your own book of 20–30 key accounts while overseeing rep coverage across the broader territory

 - Build relationships with discharge planners, case managers, and facility leadership to secure referrals

 - Deliver measurable quarter-over-quarter admission growth

2. Coach and develop your sales team

 - Coach 2–5 reps through weekly 1:1s, ride-alongs, and pipeline reviews

 - Help reps sharpen their pitch, objection handling, relationship building, and time management

 - Set clear activity expectations and hold the team accountable to performance metrics

 - Partner with your RSM to recruit and onboard new reps

3. Run a disciplined weekly operating cadence

 - Lead weekly pipeline reviews to forecast and manage opportunities

 - Track leading indicators (visits, meetings, follow-ups) and lagging indicators (referrals, admissions, episodic mix)

 - Report territory performance to your RSM with data-backed insights and recommendations

4. Build strategic facility partnerships

 - Earn credibility with key referral sources by understanding their needs and following through on commitments

 - Position Adaptive as a differentiated partner, built on care quality and operational reliability

 - Work closely with operations to ensure seamless handoffs and strong patient outcomes

5. Execute market strategy with your RSM

 - Implement the RSM's market penetration plan at the territory level

 - Share field feedback and market intelligence to inform strategy

 - Identify competitive threats and expansion opportunities

Basic Qualifications

 - 5+ years of home health sales experience, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota

 - 1+ year in a player-coach, team lead, or sales management role, or demonstrated experience mentoring peers

 - Proven ability to build relationships with facility-level decision-makers (discharge planners, case managers, clinical leadership)

 - Comfort with data-driven territory planning and performance tracking

Preferred Qualifications

 - Hospice sales experience in addition to home health

 - A track record of building and expanding referral networks

 - Experience recruiting or screening sales talent

 - Mentored junior reps who went on to become top performers

 - Established facility relationships in [market]

How You Work

 - Hungry and competitive: motivated by aggressive growth targets and performance-based compensation

 - Player-coach mentality: you want to stay in the field, and you get energy from developing others

 - Data-driven: you know your numbers and use data to make decisions

 - Coachable: you seek out feedback and keep improving your craft

 - Team player: you thrive in collaborative environments and make the people around you better

 - Low ego: you're willing to get scrappy, do the work, and support the broader team

What We Offer

 - Competitive paid time off (PTO)

 - Flexible scheduling

 - Mileage reimbursement

 - Comprehensive health insurance

 - Dental and vision insurance

 - Life insurance

title: Field Technician - Minneapolis, MN
body:
PAY: $55,000 - 65,000/YEAR + OVERTIME + STOCK OPTIONS
TRAVEL: UP TO 25%

 


THE PROBLEM

As Flock expands as a multi-product company, our physical camera and solar infrastructure footprint across public and private environments is growing. Maintaining seamless operational readiness requires hands-on technical execution across both brand-new site deployments and critical ongoing hardware maintenance. You will install, align, and service our solar panels, cameras, and infrastructure directly in the field, keeping safety hardware operating reliably across every community we serve.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Execute physical hardware installations and maintenance across camera systems, solar panels, batteries, and mounting poles.

 - Conduct thorough site surveys with public safety partners and property owners to verify traffic control plans and permit compliance.

 - Perform physical site preparation including post-hole digging, mounting hardware, and aligning LPR and PTZ cameras.

 - Diagnose and repair field hardware, software connections, and minor underground private wiring or irrigation disruptions.

 - Document completed installations, inventory logs, and service records directly through the mobile field application while managing local equipment shipments.

 - Demonstrate hands-on mechanical aptitude with power and hand tools, including comfort operating ladders, bucket trucks, and lifts at heights up to 30 feet.

 - Operate field vehicles and tow support trailers safely while adhering to environmental and workplace safety protocols.

 


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - This isn't a desk-based or remote troubleshooting role, you'll be outdoors in the field every day working on rooftops, ladders, and bucket trucks in all weather conditions.

 - This is not solely a new-installation or single-product job, your time will be split between new deployments and ongoing fleet maintenance across cameras, solar systems, and mobile trailers.

 - This isn't a fixed-schedule local role, you will travel up to 50% across your region with dynamic schedules that adapt to customer site needs.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Practical experience in low-voltage wiring, electrical assembly, construction, or technical field service environments.

 - Ability to meet physical field requirements, including lifting equipment up to 50 lbs and working outdoors independently across dynamic daily routes.

 - Capability to drive service vans, trucks, and tow small equipment trailers safely across public and private roadways.

 - Comfort using mobile applications and basic digital tools to log service records, submit site photos, and track inventory.

 - Possession of a valid driver's license is required.



TRAVEL

This position requires up to 25% travel commitment, typically consisting of 4-5 trips per year. You should expect to be in the field Monday through Friday, with the occasional Saturday required for travel or project completion.

 


COMPENSATION

In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $55,000 and $65,000, plus overtime, as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.

 

#ZR

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people.  (Internal Title: Account Strategist, Paid Social)

 - Oversee and lead a collection of Social Media accounts

 - Serve as direct support to client contacts

 - Weekly communication with any vendors or operational partners to ensure we're aligned on tasks being assigned, work quality, and any improvements we can make to that dynamic

 - Build strategies for clients each quarter

 - Have the ability to create, maintain, and optimize budgets for paid media campaigns

 - Deeply understand client positioning and unique value propositions

 - Confirm lead routing is accurate within a CRM

 - Responsible for personal productivity and utilization

 - Work directly with Associate Director to ensure internal and client goals are being achieved

 - Understand the value of Programmatic campaigns

 - Drive cross-sells, upsells and referrals via client relationships and professional network

 - Execute and optimize advertising campaigns within LinkedIn including ad copywriting, TAM development, and targeting to maximize ROI

 - 2+ years experience working at a performance/digital marketing agency, with hands-on experience supporting B2B clients

 - Deep expertise across paid social advertising campaigns, specifically LinkedIn Ads

 - Understanding of different Ad Units within the LinkedIn Platform such as conversation ads, document ads, CTV and more

 - Proficiency in using advertising platforms and tools such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Zoominfo, 6Sense, and more

 - Proven and measurable success with mid-market or enterprise accounts

 - Ability to translate and articulate strategy and tell stories with data

 - Equal parts competitive and curious; you’re a true problem solver

 - You live on the cutting edge of the industry, always looking for opportunities to grow and share

 - Ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously

 - You’re quality-obsessed and have not lost your soul for advertising

 - You encompass our core values through every interaction; internally and externally

 - Effectively manage approximately five mid-tier and enterprise accounts

 - Meet and exceed department level KPIs, such as client growth and goal attainment. Your core KPIs will be client NSMs (North Star Metrics) and Client Satisfaction scores

 - Cross-sell services that align with client goals and objectives

 - Clearly communicate results with client point of contact and executives

 - Exceptional decision making, as it relates to strategic direction for accounts

 - 🙏  Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

   - 🧠  Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
   
   - 💪  Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care

   - 💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
   
   - 🌟  Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from anywhere in the US, with the option to enjoy our state-of-the-art offices in Irvine, California. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, the UK, and Australia. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.

This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.



To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

We move fast. We think boldly. We are elite. We hire people who challenge the status quo and push campaigns past what’s expected - sparking demand for bold, innovative brands. But here’s the fun part - we don’t just deliver results; we’re shaping the future of marketing. Ready to build something that breaks the mold? Come join us.



About The Role

We’re looking for a bold, strategic Programmatic Strategist - someone who thrives in the fast-moving world of SaaS and B2B marketing and knows how to make a big impact with budgets and even bigger ideas.

The Programmatic Strategist is a crucial, client-facing role responsible for day-to-day management of our Programmatic clients, including but not limited to campaign builds, optimization, and reporting across all Programmatic Channels (Display, Native, Video, Audio, etc). They create and manage custom client strategies and communicate with clients and internal stakeholders.



What You’ll Do: 

1. Campaign Management:

 - Strategy Development: Collaborate with internal teams to create comprehensive media strategies that align with client objectives.

 - Data Integration: Leverage first-party and third-party data for precise audience targeting and segmentation.

 - Planning and Setup: Develop and implement programmatic campaigns across various Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) such as DV360, The Trade Desk, and others.

 - Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize campaigns to achieve performance and pacing goals.

 - Reporting: Generate and analyze performance reports to provide actionable insights and recommendations.

 - Troubleshooting: Quickly identify and resolve issues related to campaign performance and delivery.

2. Team Collaboration:

 - Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with creative, analytics, and account teams to ensure cohesive campaign execution.

3. Client Relationship Management:

 - Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular updates on campaign performance and strategy adjustments.

 - Presentation: Present campaign plans, performance reports, and strategic recommendations to clients.



What You’ll Bring:

 - 3+ years of proven experience in programmatic roles at publishers, advertising agencies, or ad tech companies (bonus B2B experience)

 - Hands-on expertise in media buying: building and optimizing campaigns in DSPs, with a preference for experience in TTD and DV360

 - Proven track record in Programmatic media planning, buying, and building measurement frameworks to evaluate campaign success

 - Strong understanding and perspective of how programmatic and other channels (both paid and organic) work together to holistically surpass client KPIs

 - Experience successfully driving programmatic growth across clients in the B2B/SaaS landscape with budgets over $50k/month

 - Strong cross-collaboration skills, both within the organization and externally (client-facing), with excellent interpersonal and communication abilities

 - Solid analytical ability, exceptional attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset, capable of balancing multiple projects effectively
